 NYU CRACS Co-Lab Presents: "Racial Exhaustion" by Ralina Joseph
 NYU's Critical Racial Anti Colonial Study Co-Lab invites you to a book talk for Racial Exhaustion: How to Move Through Racism in the Wake of DEI by Ralina Joseph, Professor of African American Studies and Vice Provost of Excellence at UCLA. Dr. Joseph will be joined in conversation by L'Heureux Lewis-McCoy, Associate Professor of Education at NYU Steinhardt. 
 The event, linked here , will be on Tuesday, December 1 from 5 to 6:30 PM, in the IHDSC Seminar Room. The Institute of Human Development and Social Change (IHDSC) is located at 196 Mercer Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10012. 
 The event is free to attend. You can register in advance by emailing CRACS at cracscolab@gmail.com.
